file_read.scope: Only user-selected JSON parameter/body files, UTF-8 reason or purpose files, and the explicit check-in device token file passed through fixed CLI options.
file_read.reason: Catalog actions use file-backed structured input so shell text cannot become a free request path or accidental secret-bearing command argument. The check-in token stays out of shell arguments and is encrypted with the pending operation.

target_enforcement.openai: Codex asks for access to user-selected input files and the connector reads only explicit option values.
target_enforcement.claude: Target is not released in version 0.1.1; canonical policy remains authoritative.
target_enforcement.generic: Host must expose only user-selected input files to the connector.
target_enforcement.vscode: Target is not released in version 0.1.1; canonical policy remains authoritative.

network.scope: Outbound HTTPS to one administrator-approved TokEMS origin pinned in the secure connection profile, limited to well-known, OAuth, Agent, auth step-up metadata, and catalog-declared administration paths.
network.reason: Remote product administration needs bounded API access with DPoP, live capability checks, fixed route templates, redirect denial, and organization-scoped server authorization.

target_enforcement.openai: Connector validates and pins one exact origin; Codex workspace permission remains reviewer-visible.
target_enforcement.claude: Target is not released in version 0.1.1; canonical policy remains authoritative.
target_enforcement.generic: Adapter requires the connector origin validator and redirect-denying fetch wrapper.
target_enforcement.vscode: Target is not released in version 0.1.1; canonical policy remains authoritative.

file_write.scope: Mode-0600 encrypted pending operation files under the dedicated local state directory and one explicit user-selected absolute artifact path; artifact writes reject existing files.
file_write.reason: Prepared request bodies and approved exports need bounded local persistence with AES-256-GCM, terminal-state cleanup, explicit paths, checksums, and restrictive file permissions.

target_enforcement.openai: Connector resolves dedicated state storage, rejects relative artifact paths, and applies mode 0600.
target_enforcement.claude: Target is not released in version 0.1.1; canonical policy remains authoritative.
target_enforcement.generic: Host must preserve filesystem permissions and the packaged connector checks them.
target_enforcement.vscode: Target is not released in version 0.1.1; canonical policy remains authoritative.

subprocess.scope: Fixed argument-list calls without a shell to macOS security or Linux secret-tool for credential storage and lookup.
subprocess.reason: Platform credential stores require local helper invocation; arguments are fixed, secrets pass through standard input when supported, output is captured, and no arbitrary command execution surface exists.

target_enforcement.openai: Connector uses spawnSync argument arrays with shell disabled and a strict helper allow-list.
target_enforcement.claude: Target is not released in version 0.1.1; canonical policy remains authoritative.
target_enforcement.generic: Adapter requires an approved Keychain or Secret Service helper and the same fixed invocation contract.
target_enforcement.vscode: Target is not released in version 0.1.1; canonical policy remains authoritative.

interactive.scope: Browser Device Authorization handoff and progress notices; administrator passwords remain in the TokEMS browser and the connector never reads them.
interactive.reason: Device Authorization needs a human to inspect and approve exact scopes, DPoP fingerprint, organization, and risk policy while keeping administrator credentials outside the AI process.

target_enforcement.openai: Connector emits a browser verification URL to stderr and one redacted JSON result to stdout.
target_enforcement.claude: Target is not released in version 0.1.1; canonical policy remains authoritative.
target_enforcement.generic: Host must display the verification URL and preserve the one-JSON stdout contract.
target_enforcement.vscode: Target is not released in version 0.1.1; canonical policy remains authoritative.
